svg.title: Section 09 IP Addresses visual atlas
svg.desc: Ten diagrams showing IP and MAC, binary, classes, masks, CIDR, broadcast, subnet division and UniTrack addressing.

g.text: Original educational visual atlas — illustrative addresses
IP destination normally persists; link framing changes.
Different subnets require an appropriate routing path.
Each octet is a decimal value between 0 and 255.
Binary 00100111. Sum the weights of the 1 bits.
0/8 and 127/8 are special; modern networks use CIDR.
Historical class boundaries are not current subnet masks.
Prefix bits are 1 in the mask; remaining mask bits are 0.
AND returns 1 only when both input bits are 1.
Broadcast is local-domain delivery; responses depend on protocol.
Each conventional /26 has its own network and broadcast.
Fictional capacity; routing is not application authorization.
